title: Haut-Sénégal-Niger (Soudan français), Tome 1 (de 3): le pays, les peuples, les langues

It examines the geography, peoples, and languages of French Sudan (Haut-Sénégal-Niger), synthesizing administrative monographs, field inquiries, and Arabic sources into a systematic portrait of the territory and its inhabitants. The volume classifies ethnic groups and languages and situates them within the region’s historical and administrative context. Appended documents spell out the government’s bureau structure, budgets and logistics, and issue detailed questionnaires to codify indigenous civil and criminal customs and to refresh local circle monographs. In his foreword, the author defines the scope (the country, the peoples, the languages), describes his sources and critical method (including Arabic chronicles and oral traditions), and notes the cartographic support.
